# Operator Diagnostic

Operator Diagnostic is a free, six-question commercial diagnostic for short-term rental and serviced apartment operators, part of the Operator Intelligence Suite by Roger Bisschoff. It takes about two minutes to answer and produces a ranked Growth Picture showing exactly where an operator has the most room to grow across six commercial dimensions. It is for STR and serviced apartment operators who want to know which deep-dive diagnostic tool to run first, rather than guessing. The output points to the specific tool in the suite (distribution cost, owner retention, guest experience, repeat guest value, tech stack, or unit profitability) that quantifies the biggest gap. It runs entirely in the browser: no login, no account, and no data leaves the visitor's device.
